    Free Hosting Deployment Stack (Zero Monthly Cost)

    • Frontend & Free Domain (.vercel.app): Vercel or Cloudflare Pages

    • Database & 3 Staff Logins: Supabase Free Tier (PostgreSQL + Supabase Auth)

    • Future Modules Ready: Add HOA Monthly Dues (`hoa_dues`), Vehicle Stickers (`vehicles`), and Gate Passes (`gate_passes`) as new tables linked to `block_no` + `lot_no`.

    Production Supabase PostgreSQL Schema

    Copy and paste into the Supabase SQL Editor when you set up your free cloud database.

    -- Pueblocillo NDC Housing Project (Brgy. Langkaan, Dasmariñas, Cavite)
-- Phase 1 Census Schema (Supabase PostgreSQL - Blocks 1 to 23)
create table public.village_settings (
  id int primary key default 1,
  village_name text default 'Pueblocillo Village (Brgy. Langkaan, Dasmariñas)',
  total_lots_baseline int default 480,
  updated_at timestamptz default now()
);

create table public.households_census (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  block_no int not null check (block_no between 1 and 23),
  lot_no int not null,
  street_name text not null,
  occupancy_type text not null check (occupancy_type in ('owner', 'renter', 'unoccupied', 'vacant_lot')),
  owner_name text not null,
  owner_contact text,
  tenant_name text,
  tenant_contact text,
  total_occupants int not null default 0,
  seniors_count int not null default 0,
  pwd_count int not null default 0,
  notes text,
  encoded_by text not null,
  updated_at timestamptz default now(),
  unique (block_no, lot_no)
);

-- Enable Row Level Security (Admin + 2 Encoders)
alter table public.households_census enable row level security;

create policy "Authenticated staff can read census"
  on public.households_census for select
  to authenticated using (true);

create policy "Authenticated staff can insert/update census"
  on public.households_census for all
  to authenticated using (true) with check (true);
